ayah-05.arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا ۝ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ

translations.en: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out. And will provide for him from where he does not expect.

hadith-01.arabic: إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
hadith-01.reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1 - Narrated by Umar ibn al-Khattab (RA)

translations.en: Actions are but by intentions, and every man shall have only that which he intended.

hadith-02.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ

translations.en: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

hadith-03.arabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
hadith-03.reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1956 - Narrated by Abu Dharr (RA)

translations.en: Your smile to your brother is a charity for you.

hadith-04.arabic: مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا، نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
hadith-04.reference: Sahih Muslim 2699 - Narrated by Abu Hurairah (RA)

translations.en: Whoever relieves a believer's distress of the distresses of this world, Allah will relieve him of a distress on the Day of Resurrection.

hadith-05.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
hadith-05.reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6018 - Narrated by Abu Hurairah (RA)

translations.en: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.
The best of you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.

hadith-08.reference: Sahih Muslim 2588 - Narrated by Abu Hurairah (RA)
